purpose: Train Doré on writing decisions discovered through real long-form revision without creating a parallel writing system or imitating surface style.

crossWorkValidationRequired: 《神很遠，神很近｜天國語言極簡史》

example: 保羅把神的城建在人心裡
醫院騎士團從醫院走到島嶼政權
writingTrace.rule: Learn why each transition is licensed by an entity, place, word, institution, material fact, historical consequence, or latent theological line. Never memorize the example chain as a reusable template.
writingTrace.antiPattern: Do not bridge time with narrator signposts such as 如果把時間撥回、再往前追、到了這裡我們看到、值得注意的是 when the material itself can perform the transition.

learnedPrinciples.rule: Free chronology is allowed when every jump has a material or semantic bridge and the reader retains a stable reading anchor.

When a large historical world first appears, establish enough social, geographic, linguistic, political and material background for a non-specialist reader to stand inside it before wandering further.
Do not explain every implication at first contact. Plant material, let later history increase its weight, and allow Scripture or a later return to disclose the deeper line.
The same historical material may return more than once only when the cut changes. Example: Crusades first as people and building; later as destroying, defending and being destroyed.
Put civilization back onto food, debt, land, inheritance, roads, ships, horses, walls, stone, water, bodies, institutions and time before drawing large conclusions.

Local material must serve the book-scale kinetic arc. In the first 建, human construction grows more brilliant while narrative pressure narrows; 毀 destroys a world the reader already knows; the later 建 becomes redemptive rebuilding through confession, prayer, obedience and worship.

Do not protect religious identities from evidence and do not use history as a pretext for sermonizing. State evidence honestly; let theological judgment remain under Scripture; every person finally answers to God.
Remove transitions that merely announce what the author is about to do. Prefer causal, spatial, lexical, biographical and material continuity.
A recurring person, city, gate, word or event must accumulate meaning rather than repeat explanation.
Preserve work-specific structures as profiles. Promote only transferable grammar to dimensional-writing Core after cross-work validation.

negativeTraining.failure: narrator reports the transition instead of letting material make it
generic chronological signpost becomes reusable AI scaffolding

negativeTraining.pattern: 這讓我們看到……／值得注意的是……

negativeTraining.failure: manufactured intensity and AI-like line breaks replace paragraph thought movement
interesting research is added without serving the book arc or a licensed writing trace

evaluationQuestions: Does each chronological jump have a real bridge?
Can a first-time reader identify the historical world after the jump?
Is the author announcing transitions that the material could perform?
Has meaning been explained before the narrative earned it?
Does repeated material return with a new cut and accumulated weight?
Does added flesh serve the work-scale pressure arc?
Are historical claims, reconstruction, inference and theology kept distinct?
Does the paragraph carry a complete movement without manufactured line breaks?
